description.value: Noodlebox is a Canadian fast-casual franchise serving customizable Asian-inspired noodle and rice boxes wok-fired to order with a wide variety of sauces, proteins, and noodle types. The chain operates multiple British Columbia locations and is known for bold flavours across dishes like Pad Thai, Kung Pao, and Butter Chicken. Touring cyclists would find it a practical stop for a hot, filling meal with explicit vegan and gluten-friendly modifications available on request.
